a260812p1.summary: SACRAMENTO, California — A senior OpenAI global affairs chief said AI policy is still anchored in the states …
a260812p1.title: OpenAI VP of Global Policy Ann O'Leary says AI policy in the US is anchored in the states and informed by California's AI transparency law passed last year (Chase DiFeliciantonio/Politico)

a260812p10.summary: Net profit for the three months ended June rose 35% from a year earlier — Foxconn Technology Group reported another strong quarter …
a260812p10.title: Foxconn reports Q2 revenue up 41% YoY to ~$78.4B, with cloud and networking products contributing 50%+ for the first time, and net profit up 35% YoY to ~$1.86B (Sherry Qin/Wall Street Journal)

a260812p11.summary: Former Alibaba star researcher Junyang Lin announced that he had started a new AI company, confirming The Information's earlier reports.
a260812p11.title: Former Alibaba star researcher Junyang Lin launches Shanghai-based Pragmatik Labs to build digital and physical AI agents; Pragmatik hit a $2B valuation in June (Juro Osawa/The Information)

a260812p12.summary: DeepMind's new boss is set to face intense pressure to close the AI performance gap with OpenAI and Anthropic.
a260812p12.title: A look at the challenges facing incoming Google DeepMind head Koray Kavukcuoglu, who joined DeepMind in 2012 and will oversee Gemini and frontier AI research (Kai Nicol-Schwarz/CNBC)

a260812p13.summary: A debate about recursive self-improvement. — Had Ryan Greenblatt on to discuss/debate recursive self-improvement.
a260812p13.title: Q&A with Redwood Research Chief Scientist Ryan Greenblatt on AI R&D, RSI, whether human expert data bottlenecks AI progress, token prices, alignment, and more (Dwarkesh Patel/Dwarkesh Podcast)

a260812p14.summary: As AI makes coding dramatically faster, the next big challenge in software development is testing and validating all that code.
a260812p14.title: AI code-testing startup Blacksmith raised a $45M Series B led by Peak XV Partners at a $550M valuation, up from $60M after it raised a $10M Series A in 2025 (Jagmeet Singh/TechCrunch)

a260812p15.summary: Probe targets the marketing practices of four prediction markets with operations in the city — The New York City Council …
a260812p15.title: The NYC Council sent letters to Polymarket, Kalshi, Coinbase, and Gemini Titan to investigate alleged deceptive marketing practices and targeting minors (Wall Street Journal)

a260812p16.summary: Jumia Technologies AG secured $50 million in fresh equity funding from its biggest shareholder and the World Bank's International Finance Corp …
a260812p16.title: African e-commerce company Jumia raised $50M, including ~$25M from the World Bank; its US-listed shares are down from $60+ in 2021 to $6, valuing Jumia at $743M (Loni Prinsloo/Bloomberg)

a260812p17.summary: Last week, an AI newsroom beat mainstream journalists—including WIRED—to a story about OpenAI and hacking. It's just the beginning.
a260812p17.title: A look at AI news website RuntimeWire, which costs $100/day to run and "beat" human reporters to OpenAI's Black Hat disclosure, favoring quantity over quality (Kate Knibbs/Wired)

a260812p18.summary: Skan AI, a startup that builds what it calls a “context graph of work” by observing how employees actually perform …
a260812p18.title: Skan AI, which is building a "context graph of work" by observing staff using enterprise software, raised a $63M Series C co-led by Cathay Innovation and Dell (Michael Nuñez/VentureBeat)

a260812p19.summary: Nebius Group NV reported a 514% jump in second-quarter sales for its cloud business following strong demand for AI computing power.
a260812p19.title: Amsterdam-based neocloud Nebius reports Q2 cloud revenue up 514% YoY to $575M and total revenue of $582M, above $557M est.; NBIS jumps 15%+, and is up 145%+ YTD (Paula Doenecke/Bloomberg)

a260812p2.summary: AI agents ran simultaneous reconnaissance and break-ins in display of new phase of cyberwarfare.
a260812p2.title: Researchers say suspected Chinese hackers used open-source AI agents to build an autonomous hacking tool that compromised Taiwanese government websites in July (Tom Wilson/Financial Times)

a260812p20.summary: The company, Thrive Holdings, acquires businesses to infuse them with artificial intelligence and drew interest from backers like SoftBank.
a260812p20.title: Thrive Capital's Thrive Holdings, which acquires traditional service businesses and adds AI, raised $2B from SoftBank, D1, and others at a $12B valuation (Michael J. de la Merced/New York Times)

a260812p21.summary: AI code review startup CodeRabbit said on Wednesday it had raised $143 million in a funding round that valued it at $1.5 billion.
a260812p21.title: AI code review startup CodeRabbit raised a $143M Series C co-led by Atomico and Smash at a $1.5B valuation, after raising a $60M Series B in September 2025 (Prakhar Srivastava/Reuters)

a260812p22.summary: The telecom company is staking its future on open models, both to control token cost and protect its proprietary data
a260812p22.title: AT&T says open models currently account for ~25% of its AI usage, and it targets 70% to 80% over time; AT&T uses an average of 45B AI tokens per day (Belle Lin/Wall Street Journal)

a260812p3.summary: DayOne Data Centers has confidentially filed for a US initial public offering, according to people familiar with the matter.
a260812p3.title: Sources: Singapore-based data center operator DayOne confidentially files for a US IPO, aims to list as soon as next quarter, and is considering raising ~$5B (Bloomberg)

a260812p32.summary: With the launch of the Pixel 9, Google offered fairly extensive 12-month free trials of the Google One AI Pro plan …
a260812p32.title: Google is cutting the Google One AI Pro trial bundled with the Pixel 11 Pro and other handsets from 12 to six months and removes the free trial for the Pixel 11 (Damien Wilde/9to5Google)

a260812p33.summary: Alphabet Inc.'s Google Inc. is bringing a new set of health features to its wearables, including one that tracks insulin resistance over time …
a260812p33.title: Google introduces an insulin-resistance trend feature that uses AI, an accelerometer, and other sensors, launching first on the Pixel Watch 5 and Fitbit devices (Samantha Kelly/Bloomberg)

a260812p34.summary: The Tensor G6 processor and handy new features are also on tap. — Google has introduced its latest flagships …
a260812p34.title: Google says the Pixel 11 Pro and Pro XL are its most durable Pixel phones yet, using spacecraft-grade aluminum frames and a twice as scratch-resistant coating (Mariella Moon/Engadget)

a260812p35.summary: Google DeepMind said today it wants to bring the artificial intelligence revolution to the estimated 70 million people across …
a260812p35.title: Google DeepMind launches SL2T, a multilingual sign-language-to-text model debuting on the Pixel 11 in Gboard and Live Transcribe, first for ASL to English text (Mike Wheatley/SiliconANGLE)

a260812p36.summary: If you look at a photo taken by a smartphone today, it's hard to find much that's technically wrong. Faces are bright and visible.
a260812p36.title: Google's Pixel 11 introduces Camera Looks, a total rethink of how the camera captures and styles an image, as users seek "more authentic or traditional" photos (David Imel/The Verge)

a260812p37.summary: Flight-tracking company FlightAware withdrew its lawsuit against Kalshi on Tuesday, a day after it filed the suit that accuses …
a260812p37.title: FlightAware withdraws its Kalshi lawsuit, after alleging Kalshi used its data to let users bet on flight cancellations; Kalshi no longer names it as a source (Sumedha Mukherjee/Reuters)

a260812p38.summary: ClearJet, an AI-enabled logistics technology startup, has raised a $25 million Series B, it tells Crunchbase News exclusively.
a260812p38.title: ClearJet, whose AI-enabled logistics service connects shippers with unused cargo capacity on commercial flights, raised a $25M Series B led by Edison Partners (Mary Ann Azevedo/Crunchbase News)

a260812p39.summary: Grok 4.6 builds on Grok 4.5 with a particular focus on long-running agents and more ambitious interactive and visual work. — Try for free
a260812p39.title: SpaceXAI releases Grok 4.6, saying it matches GPT-5.6 Sol on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, and prices it at $2/1M input and $6/1M output tokens (xAI)

a260812p4.summary: As India's quick-commerce platforms race to deliver everything from groceries to smartphones in minutes, electric mobility startup Yulu …
a260812p4.title: Bengaluru-based Yulu, which gets ~95% of its revenue from renting e-bikes to gig workers, raised a $93M Series C, sources say at a ~$170M post-money valuation (Jagmeet Singh/TechCrunch)

a260812p40.summary: Silicon Data, a financial data platform for the AI economy, raised $30.5 million in Series A funding led by the Valor Atreides AI Fund, CEO Carmen Li tells Axios Pro.
a260812p40.title: Silicon Data, which offers real-time compute pricing data to financial institutions and exchanges, raised a $30.5M Series A led by the Valor Atreides AI Fund (Chris Metinko/Axios)

a260812p41.summary: Bank of America (BAC.N) said on Wednesday it plans to deploy $250 billion by July 2027 to support U.S. digital and infrastructure projects …
a260812p41.title: Bank of America says it plans to deploy $250B by July 2027 to support US digital and infrastructure projects, including data centers and energy infrastructure (Reuters)

a260812p42.summary: The UK government is planning to regulate the use of artificial intelligence in gene synthesis as officials become increasingly concerned …
a260812p42.title: Sources: the UK government is planning to regulate the use of AI in gene synthesis to prevent terrorists and other bad actors from using AI for bioweapons (Ellen Milligan/Bloomberg)

a260812p43.summary: Apple Inc. hired Nate Gatten as its new head of government affairs, tapping a longtime American Airlines Group Inc. executive …
a260812p43.title: Sources: Apple hired Nate Gatten, an American Airlines exec with GOP ties, as government affairs VP, seeking someone who could align with Trump administration (Mark Gurman/Bloomberg)

a260812p44.summary: Google co-founder Sergey Brin in recent months has urged key AI staff to go all in on the company's Gemini model as parent Alphabet …
a260812p44.title: Sources detail moves behind Google's AI reshuffle; Sergey Brin urged key staff to go all in on Gemini, and some teams shifted from DeepMind to corporate Google (Kenrick Cai/Reuters)

a260812p45.summary: Kalshi, the biggest prediction market, is in advanced talks to raise at least $750 million in a new financing round at a $40 billion valuation …
a260812p45.title: Sources: Kalshi is in advanced talks to raise $750M+ co-led by Sequoia Capital and Wellington Management at a $40B valuation; Kalshi was valued at $22B in May (Yueqi Yang/The Information)

a260812p46.summary: The agency that polices the industry does not have the staffing, the legal tools or the will to broadly crack down on wagers that are easily manipulated, experts say.
a260812p46.title: Kalshi referred 32 possible insider traders to the CFTC in the three months through June; sources: CFTC has up to 20 ongoing probes using just Kalshi's evidence (Sharon LaFraniere/New York Times)

a260812p5.summary: African-focused startups are on track for a record fundraising year after investments surged in the first six months …
a260812p5.title: Briter: Africa-focused startups raised $3.3B in H1 2026, up 73% YoY, driven by Zipline's $950M raise; US- and UAE-incorporated entities raised half the capital (Nduka Orjinmo/Bloomberg)

a260812p6.summary: From marathon training to tracking office angst, health obsessives are linking their data to chatbots to build hyperpersonalized coaches
a260812p6.title: Some health and fitness obsessives are using AI for hyperpersonalized training, building custom dashboards and tools to analyze their sleep, workouts, and diet (Wall Street Journal)

a260812p8.summary: New funding round catapults AI company into the ranks of Europe's most valuable startups — Artificial-intelligence startup Lovable …
a260812p8.title: Stockholm-based AI coding startup Lovable raised $400M at a $13.3B valuation, up from $6.6B in December 2025, becoming one of Europe's most valuable startups (Ben Dummett/Wall Street Journal)

a260812p9.summary: Tencent Holdings Ltd. more than doubled spending on AI projects and computing to about $7.8 billion last quarter …
a260812p9.title: Tencent reports Q2 revenue up 11% YoY to ~$30.4B, above ~$30B est., driven by surging WeChat advertising and resilient game spending, and net income of ~$8.3B (Bloomberg)
